scenarios.prompt: Add a small, isolated behavior to the fixture repository. Follow the full Pedstack pipeline through docs sync. Keep the change limited to the requested behavior.
operatorDecisions: use the same decisions for baseline and candidate
assertions: review outcome is clean with zero findings

scenarios.prompt: Implement the fixture change with its seeded defect left in place for review. Fix every confirmed finding in the work stage, then repeat review until clean.
operatorDecisions: use the same decisions for baseline and candidate
assertions: first review has a confirmed finding
second review is clean with zero findings
transition count includes only entered stages

scenarios.prompt: Plan the fixture's multi-part change as a long plan. Save a checkpoint at the agreed boundary, resume from that checkpoint in a fresh session, and complete the plan stage with eligible explicit SOTA routing configured.
operatorDecisions: use identical explicit eligible-stage SOTA routing config
resume from the same saved checkpoint input
assertions: long plan remains bounded and complete
SOTA selection is recorded only when selected
model and Jev usage/cost stay unknown when providers omit usage

scenarios.prompt: Enter 04-5-debug with a concrete prompt, reproduce the fixture failure, fix it, run verification, and save the handoff to the next required stage.
operatorDecisions: use the same debug prompt and confirmation decisions for baseline and candidate
assertions: failing and successful verification calls have timings and outcomes
the completed review reports its findings honestly
